93wc:
The BA (Hons) Business Management degree is designed to provide practical, skills-based learning that prepares students for a wide range of career opportunities within the dynamic and evolving world of business. The programme develops knowledge across core business and management functions, building confidence and enabling graduates to pursue careers in areas such as business consultancy, government, or entrepreneurship.

A strong emphasis is placed on emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence, as well as employability and sustainability, ensuring students are well prepared for modern business environments. The course aims to develop adaptable, innovative, and agile professionals capable of responding to change and driving organisational success.

Students benefit from the use of an Assessment Centre that mirrors recruitment processes used by major organisations, helping them to develop key employability skills such as CV writing, interview techniques, and psychometric testing. The programme also supports entrepreneurial ambitions through dedicated modules, as well as access to business incubation and mentorship opportunities via STEAMhouse.

The course is accredited by the Chartered Management Institute (CMI), providing students with industry-relevant knowledge and the opportunity to gain a professional certificate upon successful completion.

Teaching is delivered through interactive and experiential learning methods, including simulations and engagement with real-world business clients. Students develop skills in negotiation, data analysis, leadership, and project management, while also gaining an understanding of contemporary and international business markets. The programme explores key areas such as human resource management, finance, strategic planning, and cultural awareness, alongside the impact of digital transformation and the ethical considerations associated with modern business practices.

The course also offers an optional professional placement year, allowing students to gain valuable industry experience after completing their second year. Students are supported in securing placements through the university’s careers services and employer networks, and may transfer to the placement version of the course once a suitable opportunity is obtained.
93we:
The BA (Hons) Business with Marketing course is designed to equip students with the knowledge and skills needed to attract and retain customers, drive business growth, and remain competitive in a constantly evolving marketplace. It combines core business understanding with specialised marketing expertise, preparing students to apply strategic thinking and practical skills in real-world contexts.

The programme develops a broad range of competencies across both business and marketing disciplines, enabling students to make an immediate impact within organisations. Through innovative and experiential learning approaches, students gain expertise in areas such as business strategy, consumer behaviour, and integrated marketing communications, while also cultivating an entrepreneurial mindset to identify and capitalise on new opportunities.

A strong emphasis is placed on emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence and data analytics, alongside key themes such as employability and sustainability. Students also have the opportunity to build a digital portfolio of certificates and accreditations, enhancing their professional profile and adaptability in a rapidly changing business environment.

The course provides a solid foundation in essential topics such as marketing principles, financial management, leadership, and business analytics, while offering flexibility through optional modules for further specialisation. It also explores the impact of digital transformation on business, including the ethical and social responsibilities associated with modern practices.

Overall, the programme prepares graduates for a wide range of career opportunities across large corporations, small and medium-sized enterprises, and entrepreneurial ventures, equipping them with the skills to succeed in diverse and dynamic industries.

The course includes an optional professional placement year, allowing students to spend a full year working with an employer after successfully completing their second year of study. This provides valuable insight into their chosen career and helps develop practical skills, with some students going on to secure long-term opportunities with their placement organisations after graduation.

Students who wish to undertake a placement are required to secure a role relevant to their field of study. They are supported throughout this process by the university’s careers services and can benefit from access to an extensive network of local, regional, and national employers. Once a suitable placement is secured, students can transfer onto the placement version of the course.
93wh:
The BA (Hons) Digital Marketing degree is a two-year fast-track programme designed to immerse students in creative, real-world marketing and advertising practices. It combines strategic thinking with hands-on experience, enabling students to develop the skills required to succeed in the dynamic digital marketing industry.

The course offers a strong focus on collaboration with creative professionals, allowing students to work on simulated advertising campaigns and deliver innovative solutions for content-driven brands. Students gain practical experience using industry-standard tools such as Adobe Creative Cloud to produce engaging campaigns and digital content for a range of regional and national clients.

Delivered through an employment-led, practice-based approach, the programme integrates academic learning with real-world application. Tutors and industry professionals support students throughout lectures and assignments, helping them to develop both professionally and personally.

Based at the City Centre Campus, students participate in creative workshops, digital media production sessions, and collaborative projects within a modern learning environment. Teaching takes place in fully equipped production studios in central Birmingham, where students have access to dedicated studio space and professional software to support their work throughout the course.
93wj:
The BA (Hons) Education Studies degree explores the role of education in shaping individuals and society, examining both theoretical and practical aspects of learning across the lifespan, from early childhood through to lifelong education.

The course encourages students to critically engage with the aims, values, and policies of education systems in the UK and internationally. Drawing on a multidisciplinary approach, it incorporates perspectives from psychology, sociology, law, history, philosophy, and politics to explore key issues and debates within education.

Central themes of the programme include the role of education in promoting social justice, equity, and inclusion; the impact of globalisation on education systems; and the influence of technological change on teaching and learning. This broad approach supports a comprehensive understanding of the evolving educational landscape.

Students also complete a practical placement during the second year, providing valuable experience within an educational setting and supporting the development of key employability skills.

The degree equips graduates with the knowledge, critical understanding, and professional skills required for a range of careers within education and related sectors.
93x7:
The BA (Hons) Events Management degree is designed to prepare students for careers within the rapidly expanding global events and leisure industry. The programme develops the skills, knowledge, and practical experience needed to plan, manage, and deliver events across a range of contexts, from large-scale venues to individual projects.

Through immersive and hands-on learning, students engage with live briefs, real-world clients, and industry-focused projects. This approach enables them to gain practical experience in designing, organising, and managing events of varying scale and complexity.

The course provides opportunities to explore major event venues and operations, offering insight into how large-scale events are planned and delivered. Engagement with industry partners and guest speakers further enhances understanding of the sector, exposing students to current challenges, trends, and professional practices.

Employability is embedded throughout the programme, supporting students in developing the skills and experience required for careers in the events industry or for entrepreneurial pathways.

An optional professional placement year is available between the second and third years of study, providing valuable industry experience. Students are responsible for securing their placement, supported by the university’s careers services and employer networks. Those who successfully obtain a placement can transfer to the placement version of the course.

The degree equips graduates with the practical, organisational, and professional skills needed to succeed in the events and leisure sector.
93wz:
The BA (Hons) Graphic Design degree is designed to develop the skills, knowledge, and confidence needed to pursue a career within the creative industries. The course supports students in bringing their ideas to life through a combination of creative exploration, technical development, and critical thinking.

Students are guided by experienced academic staff, developing a range of design approaches and problem-solving techniques that prepare them for work in a dynamic and evolving field. The programme combines practical and intellectual skill development, ensuring graduates are equipped to respond to professional challenges.

In the first year, students focus on creative experimentation, building core design skills and an understanding of fundamental principles and practices. The second year introduces opportunities to work on live briefs, providing experience of real-world projects while advancing creative and technical abilities. In the final year, students develop independence in their practice, refining their critical approach and preparing for entry into the creative industries.

An optional professional placement year is available between the second and third years of study, offering valuable industry experience. Students are responsible for securing their placement, supported by the university’s careers services and employer networks. Those who successfully obtain a placement can transfer to the placement version of the course.

The programme equips graduates with the creative, technical, and professional skills required for careers in graphic design and related fields.
93wx:
The BA (Hons) Human Resource Management degree is designed to develop the knowledge and skills required to manage and support high-performing workforces in modern organisations. The course explores key aspects of people management, enabling students to build both theoretical understanding and practical competence in areas such as recruitment, development, performance management, and employee relations.

The programme reflects the evolving nature of the HR profession, incorporating contemporary practices and emerging technologies. Students have opportunities to engage with digital and immersive tools, including applications of virtual reality, in areas such as people analytics, recruitment and selection, training, onboarding, and performance management.

Accredited by the Chartered Institute of Personnel and Development (CIPD), the course meets professional standards and supports progression within the HR field. A strong emphasis is placed on employability, with opportunities for both short-term and extended placements in the UK and internationally.

An optional professional placement year is available between the second and third years of study, providing valuable industry experience. Students are responsible for securing their placement, supported by the university’s careers services and employer networks. Those who successfully obtain a placement can transfer to the placement version of the course.

The programme equips graduates with the professional knowledge, practical skills, and industry awareness required for careers in human resource management and related areas.
940p:
The BA (Hons) Marketing degree is designed to equip students with the knowledge and practical skills needed to succeed in a fast-paced and competitive business environment, where attracting and retaining customers is essential. As marketing continues to evolve alongside technological advancements and changing consumer behaviour, the course prepares students to identify opportunities, drive growth, and maintain business relevance.

Accredited by the Chartered Institute of Marketing (CIM), the programme combines theoretical understanding with real-world application, enabling students to develop both professional expertise and the personal skills required by employers. A strong focus is placed on employability, sustainability, and emerging technologies such as artificial intelligence, simulation, and data analytics, ensuring graduates are adaptable, innovative, and ready to contribute effectively in modern workplaces.

A key feature of the course is the opportunity to work with The Link Agency, a student-led, in-house marketing agency, where students gain hands-on experience by delivering live projects for real clients. Previous clients have included Bullring Shopping Centre, Acorns Children’s Hospice, and Solihull Moors FC.

Throughout the programme, students engage in practical learning through live campaigns, which may involve product launches, rebranding strategies, event promotion, or social media optimisation. Assessment is primarily based on coursework and project work, allowing students to demonstrate their skills through real-world applications rather than traditional examinations.

Students also have the opportunity to participate in The Pitch, a national competition organised by the Chartered Institute of Marketing (CIM), where they apply their academic knowledge and creativity to real marketing challenges, further enhancing their employability.

The course includes an optional professional placement year, offering students the chance to gain valuable industry experience after their second year. With support from the university’s careers services and employer networks, students can secure placements aligned with their career goals and transfer to the placement version of the course once a suitable opportunity is obtained.
9433:
The MSc Computer Science programme is a conversion course designed to provide students with a broad and balanced introduction to the field. It aims to prepare graduates for technical roles within the IT industry by developing the key knowledge and skills required for employment.

The course offers practical experience with contemporary models, techniques, and tools that underpin innovation in software-based systems. Core areas of study include software development using industry-relevant programming languages, software analysis and design for complex systems, database design and development, full-stack web application development, and the fundamentals of artificial intelligence and machine learning.

In addition, students develop essential academic and professional skills such as research methods, academic writing, and project management. These are further applied and consolidated through the completion of an independent dissertation.

As a conversion programme, the course is designed for students with little or no prior experience in computer science. It provides structured support to facilitate a smooth transition into the discipline and to build confidence in both technical and theoretical aspects of the subject.
9431:
The MSc Management and International Business degree at Birmingham City University is designed to equip students with the essential skills and attributes required to become effective international managers. Accredited by the Chartered Management Institute (CMI), the course develops students’ ability to make strategic and tactical business decisions, understand cultural differences in global contexts, and manage and motivate teams across international organisations.

Throughout the programme, students work collaboratively in diverse, international teams on projects that mirror real-world professional practice. These projects involve producing reports and presentations as part of module assessments, helping students build practical skills. The course team provides ongoing support to help students develop their knowledge, confidence, and career readiness.

In the first stage of the course, students explore key challenges faced by global businesses, gaining insight into the complexity of leadership and management. This stage focuses on developing organisational, communication, and teamwork skills, particularly within culturally diverse environments.

In the second stage, students examine international operations management alongside corporate social responsibility, sustainability, and innovation. They also study international strategy and enhance their research skills in preparation for their final project.

The final stage consists of a Major Project tailored to individual career goals. Students can choose from three options: a work-based study linked to a current employer, a consultancy project addressing a real international business problem for a client, or a traditional dissertation involving in-depth research. This flexibility allows students to specialise in areas aligned with their career ambitions. Previous projects have explored topics such as international marketing strategy, global supply chain management in the food industry, and sustainability in cotton sourcing.
942m:
The International MBA programme in Birmingham is designed to provide students with a global perspective on management, preparing them to navigate the complexities of a rapidly changing international business environment. It recognises the need for future managers to adopt flexible approaches to thinking and behaviour in order to succeed in increasingly dynamic and unpredictable markets.

The programme explores the evolving nature of global business and equips students with the skills, knowledge, and mindset required to operate effectively across different sectors and countries. It also focuses on developing leadership capabilities, enabling graduates to lead organisations in a wide range of contexts.

Combining academic rigour with practical skill development, the course is tailored to meet the needs of contemporary international businesses. It places strong emphasis on employability, helping students build communication, interpersonal, analytical, and strategic thinking skills, alongside creative problem-solving and research capabilities. Graduates are equipped with a broad understanding of key business areas including strategy, marketing, leadership, finance, global human resource management, international business, entrepreneurship, operations and project management.

The course also supports entrepreneurial ambitions, offering opportunities to develop and test business ideas in a supportive environment. Students benefit from studying within a diverse international community and from strong industry links, including company visits, sponsored study trips, and internship opportunities that provide valuable real-world experience.

This placement helps students demonstrate professional skills, behaviours, and workplace readiness for the postgraduate job market.
